note: Written by tools/loudness-render.ts --gate <render> --names (round loudness-place, part 3): the featured tracks whose own theme, rendered whole at the trim the app plays, sits more than 1.5 LU off its band's aim (a groove by its mains and drops, a theme with few drums whole), each at the size it was measured and with what holds it (why, by hand). The featured render gate fails on a track off its aim not named here, on one more than 0.5 LU further off than named, and on a name back within 1.5 LU; the same for a limiter past its never-happen line (limits: 35 % / 12 dB on a groove, 5 % / 3 dB on a theme with few drums, whole) and a breakdown more than 0.5 LU over its groove (breakdowns). A name is the round's open work, never a waiver.

tracks.name: Vibe - Solar Wind
